main.description: A markdown body; the only member of every lessdugin md union. Exactly one of text or textBlob MUST be present (core rule G7); textBlob is allowed only in post.body, wikiRevision.body, forum.about and sequence.body.

profile.description: Markdown dialect. An unknown value is rendered as lfm/1 with a badge.

textBlob.description: Spilled LFM source, UTF-8, uploaded as text/markdown. Readers accept any text/*.

media.description: Media of this body; the only scope for cid: image URLs in it.

mentions.description: DIDs mentioned in the body. Derived by the writer; hint only.

links.description: Canonical at-uris linked from the body. Derived by the writer; hint only (pingbacks are computed from rendered bodies).
